title: 1c-DR-r4: L6 parity query forward-depends on the manifest format
description: Blocking, check b. Gate coverage's parity cells need dispatch-manifest reading, but the manifest format is Layer 8's and no data set lists a manifest schema. Fix: the dispatch-manifest schema joins the data-authoring package as a Layer 1 artifact; Layer 6 reads manifests as data. Owner: SA. Validator: DR.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the dispatch-manifest schema joins the data-authoring package as a Layer 1 artifact ('the recording fields Recorded review dispatch enumerates, shipped as versioned data so the parity queries read manifests as data'); Layer 6 reads manifests as data with no forward dependency. mdatron verify clean.
